versions.changelog:
quantumexecute-skill 1.0.3

- Internal documentation updates: improved references in safety.md and trading.md.
- requirements.txt refined for package updates or dependency clarity.
- scripts/_client.py and scripts/create_paired_order.py updated (details not specified).
- SKILL.md wording and structure updated for clarity; some institutional-grade language was simplified, default client endpoint requirement clarified.
- No new features or major breaking changes; maintenance and documentation refresh.

**Skill has been renamed with expanded algorithmic execution documentation and crypto workflow detail.**

- Skill renamed from "quantumexecute" to "crypto-algo-execution" for greater clarity.
- Description revised to highlight institutional-grade crypto algorithmic execution, with details on TWAP, VWAP, POV, and slippage control.
- Expanded documentation of execution algorithms, including urgency, maker bias, paired execution, and custom strategy parameters.
- Added Telegram community link to official resources.
- General improvements to feature descriptions, user onboarding, and parameterization to emphasize institutional and liquidity-aware execution workflows.

- License updated from MIT to MIT-0.
- Added metadata for OpenClaw environment, including env/binary requirements and homepage link.
- New section "Capability and Credential Declaration" describing credential usage and security recommendations.
- Clarified requirements for QE_API_KEY and QE_API_SECRET, with additional notes on privilege and endpoint safety.
- No functional or script changes; documentation and metadata only.

Initial release of the quantumexecute unified skill for AI-driven crypto trading workflow.

- Supports algorithmic execution across Binance, OKX, LTP, Deribit, Hyperliquid, and more via scripts.
- Provides smart order splitting, AI algorithms for large-order/quantitative trading, and multi-exchange balance/position visibility.
- Includes order lifecycle management, customizable trading strategies, plug-and-play workflows, and transaction cost analysis (TCA) tools.
- Offers clear onboarding steps for new users and detailed environment setup instructions.
- Enforces strict safety, error reporting, risk checks, and anti-fabrication rules in all workflows.
